accounting_convention: Every literal charge category in the exact source is listed. Unknown observed categories must fail accounting completeness.
P counts explicit entry/reference visits and copies, not allocator-perfect CPU instructions. Dictionary operation dispatch is non-P while its separate copied-entry/reference category is P.
Wrapper/proxy metadata copies and node/control/empty-slot inspections remain in total C but not content P.
Dictionary attempts do not measure hidden C-level hash/equality probes. Independent protocol observers report those separately.
snapshot_publications is charged before commit and may throw; only a successfully returned operation establishes completed publication.
Terminal collision categories identify actual hash-width-exhausted path operations; N16 may use an ordinary leaf dictionary with real observed equality collisions.
Factory input preparation and oracle work are external to this primitive; factory construction and its own iteration are charged.
